repaired_causal_model.statement: For a consequential action effect, an authority violation implies at least one of: semantic normalization error; point-in-time deterministic enforcement error; temporal authorization handoff/linearization error; or execution/state-transition bypass of the authoritative path.
repaired_causal_model.purpose: Make requirement-change adaptation a temporal property rather than a snapshot-only property.

minimum_contract.issuance_rule: Grant issuance is permitted only after the point-in-time normalized authority invariant passes for the exact bound action and state.
minimum_contract.commit_rule: A consequential effect may count as routed only if the grant is checked against the CURRENT authoritative epoch/state at its commit linearization point and is consumed at most once.
minimum_contract.revocation_rule: Any authority-affecting requirement change creates a new epoch/state digest; old-epoch grants fail closed.
minimum_contract.replay_rule: A consumed grant cannot authorize a second consequential effect.
minimum_contract.mismatch_rule: Action, scope, epoch, or state-digest mismatch fails closed.
minimum_contract.non_atomic_rule: If the effect cannot be coupled to the current-state consume transition, the handoff is not proved and remains explicit.

reuse_policy.one_use_primitive: Reuse generic one-use primitives only for uniqueness when their exact repository/carrier assumptions match.
reuse_policy.exact_transition_pattern: Reuse the execution_authority_reducer exact-transition pattern as design evidence, not as instruction-family proof.

closure_condition: The temporal residual closes only after an independently verified implementation or formal trace theorem proves the minimum contract over the claimed instruction-authority execution surface.
scheduler_consequence: VERIFY_STALE_EPOCH, REPLAY, ACTION_MISMATCH, STATE_DIGEST_MISMATCH, AND REQUIREMENT_CHANGE_INTERLEAVING ADVERSARIAL TRACES.
THEN RETURN ROOT3 WORK TO SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION COMPLETENESS AND UNIVERSAL ROUTE COVERAGE.
